headlines.title: Is Hiring Data Shift Altering The Investment Case For ADP Stock?
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing reported that U.S. private employers added an average of 21,000 jobs per week over the four weeks ending November 7, 2026, with its October update showing 86,000 additional jobs compared with the prior month. The ADP National Employment Report and weekly NER Pulse highlight how the company’s real time payroll data shapes views on hiring momentum and broader economic activity.

headlines.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Raises Its Dividend, Is The Stock Still Undervalued?
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) is back in focus after its latest U.S. employment report signaled continued private sector job gains, along with a higher quarterly dividend that may interest income oriented investors watching the stock. Recent trading has reflected that backdrop. The share price is up 10.45% over the past 90 days and has a 22.90% year to date share price return, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 24.77% and 5 year total shareholder return of 50.

headlines.title: 5 Low-Yield Dividend Stocks That Could Outpay Today’s High Yielders Over Time
headlines.summary: A 2% yield looks forgettable next to flashy payouts, yet one company just notched 52 straight years of raises. Five dividend growers with room to keep climbing could flip the income math, but one has a catch that demands a closer look.

headlines.title: Vanguard U.S. Momentum Factor ETF (VFMO) Adds Altria and ADP on Thursday
headlines.summary: The fund bought $13.6 million of Altria and $12.9 million of ADP while selling out of KLA and Corning.

headlines.title: ADP Acquires ZenBusiness
headlines.summary: ADP® (Nasdaq: ADP), a global leader in HR and payroll solutions, today announced that it has acquired ZenBusiness, a formation and compliance services business with an AI-powered platform that has helped over one million entrepreneurs begin their small business journey. With this acquisition, ADP can now support small businesses across all aspects of starting a business and scaling it, including business formation, insurance, payroll, compliance, HR and workforce management.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
